text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho and I decide to eat lunch
off
campus, so we head to a diner.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Whew! I am full! I think I might've eaten too much.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, the food here is pretty good. I
wonder
what I should try next...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what is this? Some kind of magic
crystal?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The kids' meal comes with a pendant
that has a
magic crystal!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! How could you miss this, Familiar? I
would
have gotten that if I knew!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... I don't care if I'm full! I'm
getting this too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: Do your best to become a great witch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Your master is saying she wants a
magical
pendant, so order the kids'
meal! Order it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I express my concern for her health if she

overeats... but she completely ignores
me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
When I say I want it, that means I want
it! I'm not
leaving until I get it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: Then I'll eat it in your place!
Then I'll eat it in your place!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I guess that could work! Excuuuse me!
One kids'
meal for my friend here,
please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wish she hadn't been so loud about it,
but seeing
Sweep Tosho so satisfied with
her toy gives me a
sense of a job well
done.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, of course! That magic crystal is as
good as
mine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she's clearly in pain from
eating so
much, Sweep Tosho finishes
every last bite and
gets the toy pendant!
